questions.prompt: Why does schemas() copy only name, description and parameters?
options: Because the model is only allowed three fields per tool
Because host-only parts such as the execute function must not go into the JSON request
Because execute is too long to send
Because the registry stores nothing else
questions.explanation: The request is JSON for the model. Functions and other host-only fields stay in the program; the model only needs the schema to ask for a call.

questions.prompt: The model calls current_tme, a name that is not registered. What does the loop send back?
options: It runs the closest matching tool
A tool error result saying the tool is unknown, paired with the call's id
questions.explanation: get returns undefined, so the loop returns an error result. Every call still gets a result, and the model can correct the name.

questions.prompt: A plugin registers a tool with ctx.effect(() => tools.register(tool)) and later unloads. What happens to the tool?
options: It is removed from the registry, because register's disposer runs with the plugin's other disposers
It stays until the program restarts
It is marked disabled but still sent to the model
It moves to the root plugin
questions.explanation: register returns a disposer that deletes the name. Wrapping it in an effect ties that disposer to the plugin's unload.
